hints.title: Sort to Maximize Progressive Growth
hints.text: Sorting the array allows adjacent elements to grow as smoothly and rapidly as possible.

hints.title: Initial Element Fix
hints.text: Set the first element of the sorted array to 1 according to the problem requirement.

hints.title: Greedy Growth Clamping
hints.text: For each subsequent element i, clamp its value to min(arr[i], arr[i - 1] + 1).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Decreasing elements arbitrarily without sorting yields sub-optimal sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the elements in O(n log n) enables a greedy linear pass in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enforces arr[0] = 1 and arr[i] <= arr[i-1] + 1 from left to right.
